text:
mira: Quick thread for the audit export docs PR I'm polishing. Two asks: add a small SDK migration note (exportLogs -> createAuditExport), sanitize examples, and fix a broken Console anchor I found. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1551
sam: Can you paste the snippets here so I can scan for PII and wording?
mira: REST curl example (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"filter":{"from":"2024-05-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2024-05-31T23:59:59Z","events":["access"]},"destination":{"type":"s3","bucket":"<REDACTORY_BUCKET>"}}'
```
dhyana: Good. For the SDK migration snippet, maybe show both old->new in one small block:
```js
// old: client.audit.exportLogs({from, to})
// new: client.audit.createAuditExport({
//   filter: {...}, destination: {type: 's3', bucket: '<YOUR_BUCKET>'}
// })
```
sam: Two wording notes: 1) add a one-line RBAC reminder (org admins only), and 2) add a UTC note: all timestamps in examples are Z/UTC. Also replace <REDACTORY_BUCKET> with <YOUR_BUCKET>.
compliance-bot: Policy reminder: public docs must not include real emails, SSNs, IPs, ARNs or credential examples. Use placeholders or internal IDs. Add an explicit callout: "Examples use masked/internal identifiers; audit logs do not expose raw PII by default."
mira: I'll add the RBAC line, UTC note, and the SOC2-safe callout above code blocks. Also the Console link in the Console nav pointed to /console/audit#exporting but the live site uses /console/audit#exports  I'll update that anchor and add a one-liner: "Old links should redirect, please update bookmarks."
buildbot: Pre-merge checklist: PR 1551 will run link checks and a PII scan on push.
dhyana: One more helpful tip: add a one-liner in the retention section: "Retention policy updates are logged as policy.update events in the audit stream; see /docs/compliance/retention for details."
mira: Nice. I'll push an update with the renamed SDK method, placeholders fixed, UTC note, RBAC line, SOC2-safe callout, anchor fix, and retention pointer. Will ping when green. :thumbsup:
